result.title: INTERACT: Learning Interaction-Aware World Dynamics from Driving Videos for Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Safe autonomous driving requires more than recognizing the current scene: the ego vehicle must anticipate how surrounding traffic participants will evolve under its own motion. However, existing end-to-end driving models typically encode scenes into dense visual or BEV features, leaving object-level interactions implicit. We propose (INTERACT INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning), a three-stage framework that learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and transfers it to trajectory planning. INTERACT first learns recurrent slots that group dense visual features into temporally structured scene-entity representations without object annotations. It then infers latent ego actions from slot context and video transitions, and uses them to condition future slot prediction, capturing how ego motion and surrounding entities co-evolve. Finally, the learned slots, latent actions, and future slot predictions are distilled into a trajectory planner to guide trajectory generation and selection. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes validate the effectiveness of INTERACT. In particular, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM, with improvements in safety-critical collision metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出三阶段的 INTERACT 框架：从无标注行车视频中学习 slot 化的物体中心世界模型，由 slot 上下文与帧间转移推断 latent ego action，并用其条件化未来 slot 预测，最后蒸馏到轨迹规划器。在 NAVSIM 与 nuScenes 上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其由状态转移反推 latent action、并以动作条件化未来 latent 状态的训练方式，可能为 LVR 中推理状态更新与监督信号构造提供可核查线索；但研究场景为驾驶世界模型，与视觉语言推理无直接关联。
